tests: cpp/tests/federation_mom_current_fdd_catch2.cpp::Embedded federation MOM exposes and refreshes HLAcurrentFDD
requirements.notes: The federation-scoped HLAcurrentFDD MOM attribute is exposed as the official HLAunicodeString encoding of the materialized, schema-validated current FDD. A compatible additional-FOM Join updates the same RTI-owned HLAfederation object through a reliable conditional reflection, and a direct Request Attribute Value Update returns the refreshed value. The native case verifies default-invalid RTI producer metadata, no sent regions, and an empty tag. This remains development-profile traceability only; remote transport, the complete module/FDD access matrix, JUnit/protected review, and conformance remain open.

tests: cpp/tests/ieee1516_2025_federation_management_catch2.cpp::Embedded federation MOM save conditionals follow pending admission and completion
requirements.notes: The federation-scoped HLAnextSaveName/HLAnextSaveTime and HLAlastSaveName/HLAlastSaveTime attributes are sourced from the authoritative save ledger. The native case checks empty initial values, a pending timestamped request with official HLAunicodeString/HLAinteger64Time encodings, a two-attribute reliable conditional reflection clearing the next values when Initiate Federate Save is admitted at the time-advance boundary, and a completion reflection updating the last values only after the snapshot succeeds. RTI-originated metadata uses the default-invalid producer, no regions, and an empty tag. The official 2025 federation MOM defines no separate restore-name/time conditional family; this remains development-profile traceability only, with restore-operation semantics, remote transport, JUnit/protected review, and conformance open.

tests: cpp/tests/ieee1516_2025_federation_management_catch2.cpp::Embedded MOM rejects malformed interactions through HLAreportMOMexception
requirements.notes: A rejected MOM Send Interaction now has a separate subscription-selected HLAreportMOMexception route. The RTI-originated reliable report targets the rejected sender's private HLAfederate dimension point, carries the fully qualified MOM interaction name, exception text, and official HLAparameterError Boolean, uses the default-invalid callback producer, and revalidates the report subscription at callback time. The bounded native case covers the malformed HLAsetSwitches empty-parameter form with HLAparameterError=true and a well-formed service-reporting adjustment rejected by its report-subscription precondition with HLAparameterError=false; it verifies HLA_EVOKED gating plus withdrawal suppression. Ordinary application interaction failures remain on HLAreportException; broader HLAservice failure families, remote transport, JUnit/protected review, and conformance remain open.
